verdict.rationale: Datalab's conversion docs claim Marker "handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images." Hands-on reports are mixed: one user found it did 'a reasonable job' but intermingled columns in tricky cases, another said tables and text boxes were messed up, and a third said it did a great job on code and config text. Missing for 10: documented handling of headers, footers and footnotes; any documented reading-order guarantees for multi-column layouts; independent evidence of correct ordering on complex real-world PDFs.

support.subject: As a developer, the API parses complex real-world PDFs — multi-column layouts, headers, footers, footnotes — into clean, correctly ordered content
